name: Bank-Payment Card Data-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: payment card data (PAN with CVV/PIN/expiry, several card numbers, magnetic tracks). Monitor-only to start; OCR on so photographed cards and scanned forms are inspected. Move to BLOCK after tuning.

name: Bank-Payment Card Data-Bulk-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: block bulk card-number exports (25+ distinct PANs or 5+ track records). Enforcing by design; ships disabled so you choose when.

name: Bank-Payment Instructions-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: bank account identifiers (ABA, EU IBAN, global IBAN, SWIFT/BIC) in payment context. Monitor-only.

name: Bank-Customer PII (Global)-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: customer personal data across jurisdictions (US SSN/ITIN, UK/CA/AU/ZA and IN/SG/HK national IDs, EU/APAC passports, DOB with US licence) plus Zscaler's US PII engine. Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries Bank-Customer PII (Global) only.

name: Bank-US PII-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: customer personal data across jurisdictions (US SSN/ITIN, UK/CA/AU/ZA and IN/SG/HK national IDs, EU/APAC passports, DOB with US licence) plus Zscaler's US PII engine. Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries ZBP-US PII only.

name: Bank-Customer PII-Bulk-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: block bulk customer-data exports (25+ distinct identifiers or 50+ dates of birth). Enforcing by design; ships disabled.

name: Bank-Customer Financial Records-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: account statements, KYC/AML case files and loan applications that carry an identifier. Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries Bank-Customer Financial Records only.

name: Bank-KYC and AML Files-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: account statements, KYC/AML case files and loan applications that carry an identifier. Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries Bank-KYC and AML Files only.

name: Bank-Credit and Loan Applications-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: account statements, KYC/AML case files and loan applications that carry an identifier. Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries Bank-Credit and Loan Applications only.

name: Bank-MNPI and Deal Information-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: material non-public information, deal documents and tax forms (Zscaler's Financial Information engine). Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries Bank-MNPI and Deal Information only.

name: Bank-Financial Information-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: material non-public information, deal documents and tax forms (Zscaler's Financial Information engine). Monitor-only. One rule per engine: this rule carries ZBP-Financial Information only.

name: Bank-Confidential Markings-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: any document stamped with a bank confidentiality marking. Monitor-only; a good first rule to enable because it has almost no false positives.

name: Bank-Credentials-Monitor
description: Inline Web DLP: private keys and secrets (Zscaler's Private Keys engine). Monitor-only.
